content: Ayissi gooppe, higgew yaana lo77obaa eeshuwaa xalalay de7ee; aw tumu leemisuu baawa. Ubba wode laythan laythan itti mala yarshshuu yarshshettee; hewaa diraw, higgii Xoossaakko shiiqiyaa asaa he yarshshuwan balay baynna asa oothanaw aynne danddayenna.
Xoossaw goyinniyaa asay bare nagaraappe ubbanna geeyyeeddabaa gidintto, sure wozanaan laa7ethuwaa nagaraa qoppenna; qassi yarshshiyaawaakka aggana.
Shin asay laythan laythan he yarshshuwan bare nagaraa hassayee.
Ayissi gooppe, korumaa suuthaynne deeshshaa suuthay nagaraa dhayissanaw ubbaakka danddayenna.
Hewaa diraw, Kiristtoosi ha alamiyaa yaana haniidde, hawaadan yaageedda;

content.text: Taani he wode, ‘Xaatha maxaafan tabay xaafetteeddawaadankka,
Xoossaw, taani neeni koyiyaawaa oothanaw yaaddi’ yaagaaddi”

content: yaageedda.

Yarshshuu yarshshettana mala, higgii azaziyaawaa gidooppenne, Kiristtoosi koyro, “Neeni yarshshuwaa, imotaa, xuuggiyaa yarshshuwanne nagaraa yarshshuwaa ubbaakka koyyabeykka; hewaanttun nashettakka” yaageedda.
Hewaappe guyyiyan Kiristtoosi, “Xoossaw, taani neeni koyiyaawaa oothanaw yaaddi” yaageedda. Hewaa diraw, Kiristtoosi laa7enthuwa essanaw koyrowaa dhayissee.
Yesuusi Kiristtoosi Xoossay koyyeeddawaa ootheedda diraw, bare ashuwaa laa7enthennaan itti gede yarshsheeddawan nuuni nu nagaraappe geeyyi aggeeddo.
Qeesatuwaa ubbatuu hachche hachche eqqiide, bare oosuwaa oothiino; qassi nagaraa dhayissanaw ubbaakka danddayenna itti mala yarshshuwaa zaari zaariide yarshshiino.
Shin Kiristtoosi nagaraa diraw, ubba wodew gideedda itti yarshshuwaa yarshshiide, Xoossaappe ushechcha bagganna utti aggeedda.
Xoossay sinthappe Kiristtoosa morkketuwaa Kiristtoosaw gediyan yedhdhiyaawaa oothana gakkanaw, yaani naagee.
Ayissi gooppe, I itti gede yarshsheeddawan, nagaraappe geeyyeeddawantta medhinaw balay baynnawantta ootheedda.
Qassi Geeshsha Ayyaanay nuussi markkattiidde, hawaadan yaagee;

content.text: Taani ta higgiyaa unttunttu qofaan wothana;

content: yaagee.
Qassi hewaappe guyyenna,
yaagee.
Xoossay he nagaraa atto geedda wode, nagaraa dhayissanaw hawaappe sinthaw yarshshuwaa koshshenna.
Xoossaakko Shiiqanaw Koshshee
Simmi taanaadan ammaniyaawanttoo, nuuni Yesuusa suuthaa bagganna Ubbaappe Aadhdhiyaa Geeshsha sa7aa gelanaw nuussi xalatethay de7ee.
Kiristtoosi nuussi ooratha ogiyaanne de7uwa ogiyaa gaariduwaa bagganna, hewaa guussay bare bollaa bagganna dooyyeedda.
Nuussi Xoossaa gollen sunthetteedda wolqqaama qeesay de7iyaa diraw,
Nuuni suure wozanaanna, tumu ammanuwaanna, iita wozanaappe geeyyeedda wozanaannanne qassi xillo haathaan meecetteedda bollaanna Xoossaakko shiiqoytte.
Nuussi immana geedda Xoossay ammanthiya diraw, nuuni demmana giide nashechchaan naagi utteeddawaa loythi oyqqoytte.
Ittu ittuwanna waani siiqettanenttonne qassi lo77o oosuwaa wooti oothanentto, ittu ittuwassi qoppeetto.
Ittu ittuu shiiquwaa dooya udiide shiiqiyaawaadan, nuunikka ittippe shiiqiyaawaa aggokko; shin Godaa gallassay matattiyaawaa hinttenttu be7iyaa diraw, ittu ittuwaa menthetheetto.
Nuuni tumatethaa era akkidiggiide, eriidde nagaraa oothiyaawaa gidooppe, hawaappe sinthaw nagaraa dhayissiyaa yarshshuu ittibaynne baawa.
Shin yashshiyaa pirddaa naagiyaawenne Xoossaa ixxiyaa ubbaa maanaw wolqqaama tamay de7ee.
Muse higgew azazettenna uray, laa77u uray woy heezzu uray A bolla markkattooppe, qareti baynnaan hayqqee.

Xoossaa Na7aa kadheedda uray, barena nagaraappe geeshsheedda Xoossaa caaquwaa suuthaa tunabaadan qoppeedda uray, qassi aadho keekatethaa Geeshsha Ayyaanaa boriyaa uray, ay keena iita pirddaa akkanaw bessinttonne ane qoppite.
Ayissi gooppe, “Taani haluwaa kesananne kushiyaa zaarana” geeddawaa nuuni ereetto; qassikka, “Goday bare asaa pirddana” yaageedda.
De7uwa Xoossaa kushiyan kunddanawe daro yashshiyaawaa.
Hinttenttussi Xoossaa poo7uu poo7eeddawaappe guyyiyan, hinttenttu daroban waayyettiide, wolqqaama wadhetaan gencceedda beni wodiyaa hassayite.
Itti itti gede hinttentta asaa sinthan boreeddinonne paxa kaa7eeddino; qassi hara wode hewaadan ootheeddawanttunnanne ittippe de7eeddita.

Ayissi gooppe, qashuwan de7iyaa asatuwaassi hinttenttu qaretteeddita; yaatiide hinttenttussi medhinaw wurenna ubbaappe aadhdhiyaa shaluu saluwan de7iyaawaa hinttenttu huuphew ereedda diraw, hinttebaa ubbaa akkidigooppe hidootaan gencceeddita.
Hewaa diraw, wolqqaama woyitaanna de7iyaa hinttenttu xalatethaa oloppite.
Xoossay koyyiyaawaa udiide, I hinttenttussi immana geeddawa akkanaw genccana koshshee.
Ayissi gooppe, Xoossaa Maxaafay,
yaagee.
Nuuni ammanettiide atteeddawanttu bagga gidiyaawaappe attin, guyye simmiide dhayeeddawanttu bagga gidokko.
